prompt.alinti: If you're vibe coding with Cloud Code or Codex, then here are five plugins you guys need to have. The first is Playwright CLI. This will give your AI the power to open browsers, screenshot what it just built, and catch messy outputs and errors before you guys even see it. The second is the Supabase plugin. This will help you build entire databases for your apps and manage them without ever having to leave your terminal. The third is Strix, which will attack your vibe coded app just like a real hacker and find and fix any security vulnerabilities that you guys have left behind. The fourth is Skill UI for frontend, where you point it at any site that you like and it'll literally go through and reverse engineer the whole design system into a markdown file. So your AI can build that project in the exact same style. And the fifth is Context 7, which provides your coding assistant with the latest version of all of the libraries, tools, and dependencies that top performers use so they'll never have to code against an outdated version again.
